hook.en: Every February the Finance Minister stands up in Parliament with the budget. Free rations, new highways, the salaries of teachers and soldiers, and the taxes we pay are all in it. What is a budget and why does a *government* need one?

say.en: Every February the Finance Minister stands up in Parliament with the budget. Free rations, new highways, the salaries of teachers and soldiers, and the taxes we pay are all in it. What is a budget and why does a government need one? In this lesson: Define the government budget.
Explain the allocation, redistribution and stabilisation functions.
Name the revenue and capital accounts.

body.en: The government *budget* is a statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the government for a financial year (1 April to 31 March). Under Article 112 of the Constitution it is laid before Parliament as the Annual Financial Statement. It has two parts: the revenue budget (revenue receipts and revenue expenditure) and the capital budget (capital receipts and capital expenditure).

narration.kn: ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ಹಣಕಾಸು ವರ್ಷದ (ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 1 ರಿಂದ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 31) ಅಂದಾಜು ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳ ವಿವರಣೆ. ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 112ನೇ ವಿಧಿಯಂತೆ ಇದನ್ನು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಹಣಕಾಸು ವಿವರಣೆಯಾಗಿ ಸಂಸತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಡಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಆದಾಯ ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ.

explanation.en: Public goods are non-rival and non-excludable, so markets under-supply them (allocation). Taxes and transfers make incomes fairer (redistribution). Spending and taxes smooth booms and slumps (stabilisation).

body.en: Allocation function: the government provides public goods such as defence, roads and street lights, which are non-rivalrous and non-excludable, so markets would under-supply them (the free-rider problem). Redistribution function: through progressive taxes and transfers (pensions, subsidies, free rations) it makes the distribution of income fairer. Stabilisation function: it uses spending and taxes to reduce fluctuations in output and prices, fighting inflation and unemployment. The *budget* also aims at economic growth and managing public enterprises.

narration.kn: ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಕಾರ್ಯ: ರಕ್ಷಣೆ, ರಸ್ತೆ, ಬೀದಿದೀಪಗಳಂತಹ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸರಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವುದು. ಮರುಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಕಾರ್ಯ: ಪ್ರಗತಿಪರ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಆದಾಯ ಅಸಮಾನತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು. ಸ್ಥಿರೀಕರಣ ಕಾರ್ಯ: ಹಣದುಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವುದು. ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯೂ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು.

problem.en: Classify each budget item by function: (a) building a national highway, (b) old-age pensions for poor families, (c) cutting government spending when inflation is high.

steps.en: (a) A highway is a public good used by all: allocation function.
(b) Pensions transfer income to the poor: redistribution function.
(c) Reducing spending to cool down prices: stabilisation function.
